in_sanskrit.name: Ainav
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of wisdom, intelligence
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ainav एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ainav is a Hindu name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'aina', meaning 'knowledge' or 'wisdom'. This name is a tribute to the Lord of wisdom and intelligence. The name is believed to bring calmness and a deep sense of love in one's life.
